title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry — Schedule of Registry Types, Occasions and Creation Limits
content:
The Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry is offered in six registry types, each for its own occasions. The figures below fix, per registry type, when a registry may be opened relative to the event date, who may hold it, how it is shown and how large it may grow.

## Occasions and opening window

| Registry type | Offered for | Event date at most this many full calendar months after the creation date | Event date at most this many calendar days before the creation date | Minimum registrant age (whole years) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | birthday, retirement and milestone celebrations | 12 | 0 | 18 |
| Graduation Registry | graduation and dorm move-in | 12 | 0 | 16 |
| Housewarming Registry | a new home | 12 | 30 | 18 |
| Baby Registry | a birth or adoption | 12 | 90 | 18 |
| Anniversary Registry | an anniversary or vow renewal | 12 | 0 | 18 |
| Wedding Registry | a wedding or commitment ceremony | 24 | 180 | 18 |

A figure of 0 days means the event date may not already have passed on the creation date: the registry is opened on or before the event date.

## Holders, display and size

| Registry type | Co-registrant may be named | Registries of this type held at once in active or completion status | Visibility settings | Distinct items on one registry | Requested quantity of one item |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | no | 1 | public, private | 100 | 4 |
| Graduation Registry | no | 1 | public, private | 100 | 4 |
| Housewarming Registry | yes | 1 | public, private | 200 | 12 |
| Baby Registry | yes | 1 | public, private | 300 | 12 |
| Anniversary Registry | yes | 1 | public, private | 200 | 12 |
| Wedding Registry | yes | 1 | public, private | 500 | 24 |

Every registry type issues a public registry number in the same format: the letter R followed by 8 digits.

## Schedule notes

- The month limit counts **full calendar months**; the day limit counts **calendar days**.
- The distinct-item limit counts different item numbers on the registry; the quantity limit applies to each item number separately.
- *Illustration (hypothetical):* a Housewarming Registry may hold up to 200 different item numbers, each requested in a quantity of up to 12; a Graduation Registry reaches its limits at 100 item numbers and 4 units of any one of them.
